data.table_name: Population size (at the beginning of year)
data.description: This dataset presents statistical data on the population size of the Republic of Azerbaijan from 1995 to the beginning of 2026. The dataset reflects data on the population size by gender breakdown across the country, as well as by urban and rural areas, showing the annual changes in these indicators. The indicators are expressed in thousands of people. The dataset is updated annually and published at the beginning of April each year. It has been developed to analyze the changes in the country's population size.

data.table_name: Distribution of employed population by economic activities, economic regions and administrative territorial units, thsd. persons (as of January 1, 2025, 2026)
data.description:
«0,0» - data characterized by the least number

This dataset provides statistical information on the distribution of employed persons by economic regions, administrative-territorial units and economic activities in the Republic of Azerbaijan for the period 2018–2025. The dataset presents the total number of employed persons and employment figures for Baku city, the Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic, economic regions, and their constituent cities and districts, covering agriculture, industry, construction, trade, transport, education, healthcare and other economic activities. The indicators are used to analyse the sectoral structure of regional employment, differences across economic activities, and changes in the number of employed persons over time. The data refer to 1 January of each year, are expressed in thousands of persons and are presented on an annual basis.

data.table_name: Educational attainment of pedagogical staff in state and non-state preschool educational institutions (at the beginning of the year) (2005-2026)
data.description: The dataset shows the annual changes in the indicator "Educational level of pedagogical staff in public and non-public preschool educational institutions (at the beginning of the year)". The dataset has been prepared for the purpose of tracking the dynamics of the educational level and qualification structure of preschool pedagogical staff, analyzing changes, and making comparisons across various periods (years 2005–2026). The update frequency of the dataset is annual.

data.table_name: Capital investments to the transportation and storage, information and communication sectors
data.description: This dataset reflects statistical data on investments in fixed capital directed to the transportation and warehousing sector, as well as the information and communication sectors, on a cumulative total basis. The dataset reflects the value of investments in fixed capital for the development of transport infrastructure, the modernization of warehousing, the expansion of communication networks, and digital technologies, as well as the monthly dynamics and changes in these indicators. The indicators are expressed in thousand manats. The dataset is updated on a monthly basis. The dataset has been prepared for the purpose of collecting and analyzing statistical data on investment activities in the transport, warehousing, and information-communication fields.

data.table_name: Number of employees holding civil service positions by economic regions and age groups as of January 1, 2025, person
data.description: This dataset provides statistical information on the number of employees holding civil service positions and their distribution by age group across economic regions of the Republic of Azerbaijan as of 1 January 2025. The dataset presents the total number of civil servants and those holding qualification ranks in Baku city, the Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic and individual economic regions, with breakdowns by administrative and auxiliary position classifications and specific job titles. The age distribution covers persons under 25, five-year age groups from 25–29 to 60–64, and persons aged 65 and over. The indicators are used to analyse the territorial and occupational structure of civil service employment, the age composition of employees and the distribution of civil servants holding qualification ranks. The indicators are expressed in persons.

data.table_name: Distribution of teachers of state general educational institutions by level of education (excluding special educational institutions for children with limited health;  for the state of 1st October)
data.description: The dataset presents the indicator “Distribution of teachers in state general education institutions by level of education (excluding special educational institutions for children with disabilities; as of October 1) (2000–2025)”. The dataset has been prepared for the purpose of monitoring, analyzing, and comparing the annual dynamics of the total number of teachers (main staff) in state general education institutions, their percentage distribution by level of education (higher, including pedagogical), and the share of women among the total number of teachers. The updating frequency of the dataset is annual, with publication carried out by the end of May each year.

data.table_name: Export directed to other countries
data.description: Exports comprise goods produced in the country and shipped abroad, as well as re-exported goods. Goods produced in foreign countries, imported into the country and subsequently processed in such a way as to change their principal characteristics or technical specifications are also classified as goods produced in the country. Goods imported into the country and subsequently exported without undergoing any processing are referred to as re-exports. The value of exports in recorded at FOB prices or at the franco-border prices of the exporting country. This means that the value of the goods includes the cost of the goods, as well as the costs of delivering them to the country’s land border or port of shipment and loading them on board the vessel.

data.table_name: Income and expenditure of population (current prices, million manat)
data.description:
This dataset covers statistical data on the income and expenditure of the population of the Republic of Azerbaijan for 2003–2025. The dataset presents annual income and expenditure at current prices and reflects changes in these indicators over time.

The indicators are expressed in million manats. The data describe the levels of the population’s income and expenditure, their changes over the years, and the difference between income and expenditure. These indicators are used to assess the population’s financial situation, compare income and expenditure, and evaluate the population’s economic situation.

data.table_name: Main social-economic indicators of the labour market (1990-2025)
data.description: This dataset provides statistical information on the main socio-economic indicators of the labour market in the Republic of Azerbaijan for the period 1990–2025. The dataset includes information on the labour force, employed and unemployed population, including employed women, employment in the public and non-public sectors, the number of employees, persons granted unemployed status by public employment authorities and recipients of unemployment benefits, as well as average monthly nominal wages and the real wage index. Selected indicators are presented separately for the oil and gas and non-oil and gas sectors. The dataset is designed to analyse the dynamics of key labour market indicators, the structure of employment, trends in wages and changes over time, as well as to enable comparisons across different periods. The indicators are expressed in thousands of persons, persons, Azerbaijani manats (AZN) and percentages, and the data are updated annually. The labour force represents the total number of employed and unemployed persons, while average monthly nominal wages refer to the average monthly amount of wages accrued to employees.

data.table_name: Main indicators of education (at the beginning of school year) (1990-2025)
data.description: The dataset presents the annual change in the indicator 'Main indicators of education (at the beginning of the academic year; persons) (1990–2025)'. The dataset has been prepared for the purpose of tracking the dynamics of key educational indicators over the years, analyzing changes, and conducting comparisons across different periods. The updating frequency of the dataset is annual, with publication carried out by the end of May each year.

data.table_name: Main indicators of science (2000, 2005, 2008–2025)
data.description: "The dataset reflects the chronological trend of the indicator “Main indicators of science (2000, 2005, 2008–2025)”. This dataset is developed to track the annual dynamics, analyze changes, and perform comparative evaluations across different periods regarding the number of research and development organizations, the number of research personnel (including women, Doctors of Sciences, and Doctors of Philosophy), as well as scientific and pedagogical staff in higher education institutions and other entities. The dataset is updated annually and is published by the end of September each year."

data.table_name: Main indicators of culture (at the end of the year) (1990-2025)
data.description: The dataset shows the change in "Main indicators of culture (at the end of the year)(1990-2025)" over the years. The dataset is prepared for the purpose of monitoring the dynamics of cultural institutions and the sector over the years, analyzing their changes, and making comparisons across various periods. The update frequency of the dataset is annual, and its publication is carried out by the end of May each year.

data.table_name: Main indicators of healthcare (at the beginning of the year), (1995-2026)
data.description: The dataset presents the annual changes in the "Main indicators of healthcare (2021–2026)", including the number of physicians, paramedical personnel, hospitals, and outpatient clinics. The dataset has been developed to track the annual dynamics of the healthcare facility network, bed capacity, and staffing levels in the country, analyze changes in healthcare infrastructure, and conduct comparative analyses across different periods. The dataset is updated annually, with its publication carried out by the end of August each year.

data.table_name: Number of persons with disabilities receiving pensions or benefits (as of the beginning of the year, person) (2000-2023)
data.description:
The dataset “Number of persons with disabilities receiving a pension or allowance (at the beginning of the year, persons) (2000–2023)” shows the annual changes in the total number of persons with disabilities receiving a disability pension or disability allowance.

A disability allowance is granted to a person whose disability has been established by a decision of the relevant authority (institution) designated by the competent executive authority, when the person does not have the right to receive a labor pension.

A disability labor pension is granted in connection with a limitation of the insured person’s ability to work resulting from mental or physical impairments caused by illness or injury.

The dataset is updated annually and is published by the end of August of each year.

data.table_name: Sport facilities, at the end of the year (1995-2025)
data.description: The dataset reflects the annual changes in indicators for "Sports facilities, end of the year (1995–2025)". The dataset was developed to track the annual dynamics of sports infrastructure and the material-technical base in the country, as well as to conduct sectoral analyses and comparisons across different periods. The update frequency is annual, with publications released by the end of august each year.

data.table_name: Fires and its reasons, incident
data.description: Recorded fires include uncontrolled burning incidents that cause material damage and harm to human life and health. The dataset is updated annually, with publication taking place in September.

data.table_name: Use of the gross domestic product (at current prices, million manats)
data.description: This dataset presents a breakdown of the components of gross domestic product (GDP) by use in the Republic of Azerbaijan for the period 1993–2025 on a quarterly and annual basis. The dataset includes data on final consumption expenditure, gross capital formation, and net exports. The figures are expressed at current prices in million manats. The dataset was prepared to support the analysis of time series data on the breakdown of GDP by use in the Republic of Azerbaijan.

data.table_name: Number of farm animals, poultry and bee families 1 January
data.description:
These data cover the period 1995-2026 as of 1 January of each year and reflect the number of animals, poultry and bee colonies in all categories of farms, including agricultural enterprises, individual entrepreneurs, family peasant farms and households. The indicators for animals and poultry are expressed in thousand head, while the number of bee colonies is expressed in thousand units, and compiled and presented annually as of the end of March of each year. The data have been prepared for analytical purposes, i.e. to track the dynamics of the number of these units over the years, determine the production potential of livestock products, as well as assess the share of the sector, structural potential and differences across several farm categories.

Animals, poultry and bee colonies include the total number of cattle (including cattle herds), sheep and goats, pigs, horses, camels, donkeys, mules, poultry and bee colonies.

data.table_name: Sown area of agricultural crops, by farm categories
The number of active industrial enterprises (by types of economic activity), unit
data.description: This dataset contains statistical information on the number of active enterprises operating in the industrial sector for 1995–2025. The dataset presents the number of active industrial enterprises by economic activity and changes in the indicators over the years. The indicators are expressed in units. The dataset is updated annually and published by the end of August each year. The dataset is prepared for analysing the structure and dynamics of active industrial enterprises by economic activity.

data.table_name: Consumption of electricity, million kWh (for the years 1995–2025)
data.description: This dataset presents statistical information on electricity consumption in the Republic of Azerbaijan for the period 1995–2025. It shows the annual changes in electricity consumption based on the total volume of electricity consumed nationwide. The indicator is used to analyse trends in electricity consumption, assess changes over time, and compare different periods, as well as to examine the use of electricity in the country's energy supply. The data are expressed in million kWh, updated annually, and published by the end of August each year. Electricity consumption represents the total volume of electricity used within the territory of the country during a specified period.

data.table_name: Submitting into use of residental building
data.description: This dataset covers statistical data on residential buildings put into operation for the years 1995–2025. The dataset reflects the total area and number of residential buildings commissioned, housing constructed at the population's own expense, total area per 1,000 persons, number of apartments, as well as the number of apartments per 1,000 persons, along with the dynamics and changes in these indicators over the years. Indicators are expressed in thousand square meters for area and in units for count. The dataset is updated annually and published by the end of August each year. The dataset was prepared for the purpose of collecting and analyzing statistical data on residential buildings put into operation.

data.table_name: Housing fund - total, million square meters
data.description: Housing fund comprises all residential premises located within the territory of the Republic of Azerbaijan. The dataset is updated annually, resulting in its publication in September.

data.table_name: Volume of retail trade turnover, public catering  and paid services rendered to population (million manats)
data.description: The indicators are shown in old Azerbaijani manat (AZM) without considering denomination of manat (1990-1994).

data.table_name: Exports of countries Commonwealth of Independent States
data.description: Exports comprise goods produced in the country and shipped abroad, as well as re-exported goods. Goods produced in foreign countries, imported into the country and subsequently processed in such a way as to change their principal characteristics or technical specifications are also classified as goods produced in the country. Goods imported into the country and subsequently exported without undergoing any processing are referred to as re-exports. The value of exports in recorded at FOB prices or at the franco-border prices of the exporting country. This means that the value of the goods includes the cost of the goods, as well as the costs of delivering them to the country’s land border or port of shipment and loading them on board the vessel.

data.table_name: Main indicators of post communication
data.description: This dataset covers statistical information on the main indicators of postal services for the period 1995–2025. It includes the number of postal workers and couriers, broken down by urban and rural areas; the number of newspapers and magazines, letters, parcels, money orders, pension payments and telegrams sent; mail transported by air; and the number of post offices, also broken down by urban and rural areas. The dataset also reflects the annual trends and changes in these indicators. The indicators are expressed in persons for personnel numbers, million items for postal items, million payments for pension payments and money orders, and thousand tonnes for weight-based indicators. The dataset is updated annually and published by the end of July each year. It has been compiled for the purpose of collecting and analysing statistical data on the postal services sector.

data.table_name: Average annual number of workers in transport sector
data.description: This dataset provides statistical information on the average annual number of employees in the transport sector for the period 1998–2025. It presents statistics on the average annual number of employees in individual subsectors and shows changes in the indicators over the years. The indicators are expressed in thousands of persons. The dataset is intended to analyse the trends and structure of the average annual number of employees. The data are released annually by the end of september.

data.table_name: State budget expenditures, in million manat (1995–2019)
data.description: This dataset presents statistical data on state budget expenditures of the Republic of Azerbaijan for 1995–2019. It presents data on state budget expenditures by main expenditure categories and shows changes in the indicators over the years. The indicators are expressed in million manats. The dataset has been prepared to analyze the dynamics and structure of state budget expenditures in the Republic of Azerbaijan.

data.table_name: Consumer price index (compared to the previous year, in percent)
data.description:
This dataset contains statistical information on consumer price indices for the period 1995–2025. The dataset presents indices compared with the previous year for the relevant groups of goods and services, including food products, beverages and tobacco products, non-food products, and paid services, and reflects changes in the indicators over the years. The indicators are expressed as percentages.

The dataset is updated annually and has been developed for the analysis of price dynamics and trends in goods and services

data.table_name: Catering turnover
data.description: The data on catering turnover included in this indicator dataset cover the period from 1995 to 2025. The dataset contains information on catering activities, including catering turnover, the public sector, the private sector, and catering turnover per capita. Catering turnover is expressed in million manats, while catering turnover per capita is expressed in manats. The data are collected on an annual basis and become available by the end of February of each year.

data.table_name: Volume of paid services rendered to population
data.description: Value of Paid Services Provided to the Population – a statistical indicator characterizing the total value of paid services provided to the population and their distribution by forms of ownership. The indicator covers statistical data for 1995–2025. The total value of paid services provided to the population represents the total monetary value of paid services provided to the population and is expressed in thousand manats. The table presents statistical indicators characterizing the distribution of paid services provided to the population by legal entities and individuals, as well as by state and non-state ownership. It reflects changes and trends in the indicators over the years. The indicator has been developed for the statistical analysis of the volume of paid services provided to the population in the Republic of Azerbaijan, as well as their structure and trends by ownership and types of service providers.

data.table_name: Main indicators of travel agencies and touroperators
data.description:
The data in this dataset on the main indicators of travel agents and tour operators covers the period from 2001 to 2025. The dataset contains information on the main indicators of travel agents and tour operators, including the total number of employees engaged in tourism activities, of which the number of employees directly engaged in tourism activities, and the number of travel agents and tour operators.

The total number of employees engaged in tourism activities and the number of employees directly engaged in tourism activities are expressed in persons, while the number of travel agents and tour operators is expressed in units. The data are collected annually and become available by the end of March of the following year.

The dataset has been prepared for the purpose of analyzing the main indicators of travel agents and tour operators.

data.table_name: Average size of budget-surveyed households by economic regions, persons
data.description: This dataset covers statistical information on the average household size of households surveyed for budget purposes by economic region, starting from 2001. It presents the average household size by economic region and shows changes in the indicators over time. The indicators are expressed in persons. The dataset is updated annually and published by the end of April each year. It has been developed to analyze the trends and structure of the average household size of households surveyed for budget purposes across the economic regions of the Republic of Azerbaijan.

data.table_name: National parks, state natural reserves and wildlife refuges (by the end of the year)  (1990-2025)
data.description: This dataset covers statistical indicators on national parks, state nature reserves, and wildlife sanctuaries in the Republic of Azerbaijan. The dataset provides a breakdown of core indicators and reflects their annual changes. Units of measurement are expressed in thousand hectares and thousand manats. The primary objective of this dataset is to analyze the trends and structural composition of the number, total area, and budgetary allocations of national parks, state nature reserves, and wildlife sanctuaries. The dataset follows an annual frequency, with the release scheduled for September of each year.

data.table_name: Core indicators on availability and use of ICT in households
data.description: This dataset provides statistical information on key indicators relating to the availability of ICT systems in households and their use for 2005–2025. It presents statistics on the availability and use of ICT systems in households and shows changes in the indicators over the years. The indicators are expressed as percentages. The dataset was prepared to analyse the trends and structure of statistics on the availability and use of ICT systems in households. The data are released by the end of September each year.

Dövlət аli təhsil müəssisələri (tədris ilinin əvvəlinə), (1990-2024-cü illər)

Məlumat dəstində “Dövlət ali təhsil müəssisələri (tədris ilinin əvvəlinə), (1990-2024-cü illər)” göstəricisi təqdim olunur. Məlumat dəsti ölkədə fəaliyyət göstərən dövlət universitetlərinin, akademiyalarının və digər dövlət ali məktəblərinin şəbəkə dinamikasının izlənilməsi və dövlət ali təhsil infrastrukturunun inkişaf meyllərinin təhlili məqsədilə hazırlanmışdır. Yenilənmə dövriliyi illik olmaqla, hər ilin may ayının sonunadək yayılır.

The dataset presents the indicator "State higher education institutions (at the beginning of the academic year), (1990-2024)". The dataset has been prepared for the purpose of tracking the network dynamics of state universities, academies, and other state higher education institutions operating in the country, and analyzing the development trends of the state higher education infrastructure. The update frequency is annual, and it is disseminated by the end of May each year.
